text: Drink a glass of water slowly, like it's a treat.
Step outside and look at the sky for one whole minute.
Send a friend a message that just says why you like them.
Stretch like a cat who just woke up.
Play one song you loved at fifteen. Dance a little.
Thank someone who usually goes unthanked.
Tidy one tiny corner. Just one.
Take a ten-minute walk with no phone.
Give a stranger a genuine compliment.
Water a plant, or say hello to a tree.
Breathe in for four, hold for four, out for six. Three times.
Doodle something silly in the margin of anything.
Open a window and let fresh air in.
Eat a piece of fruit really slowly and notice every bite.
Take a photo of something small and beautiful.
Write two lines to future you in the capsule.
Call someone instead of texting.
Watch something that makes you laugh out loud.
Let go of one tiny grudge today.
Look up something you've always wondered about.
Sit in the sun for five minutes.
Spend the first ten minutes after waking without a screen.
Write down one thing you did well today.
Make yourself something warm to drink, with care.
Hug someone (a pet absolutely counts).
Listen to a whole album with your eyes closed.
Read five pages of a book just for fun.
Roll your shoulders back and unclench your jaw.
Leave a little note for someone to find.
Find a cloud shaped like an animal.
Use today's word in a real sentence.
Delete ten photos you don't need.
Make your bed like a fancy hotel.
Recall your favourite memory from this year.
Hum your favourite tune while doing chores.
Put one thing you no longer use aside to give away.
Stand barefoot on grass or a cool floor.
Do one ordinary thing at half speed.
Ask someone how they're really doing, and listen.
Tell someone you're proud of them.
